answer: Price the copy before the reward: each identity repeats setup, bonding and review, so replication cost scales linearly while payout per clone stays flat. Convert every payout into a slow vesting stream released over many epochs. Draw auditors from a rotating pool so a farm cannot buy its own jury. The tide of new identities must then fund a forge of duplicate work before it reaches an oasis of profit, and most farms run dry on the way.
